summary: The Form 6-K reports a PIPE transaction where Baosheng Media issued 25,000,000 ordinary shares for $12.5M aggregate (blended price ~$0.50/share). The registrant is the issuer. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement — a private placement under Regulation S with no change of control, tender offer, or strategic restructuring. It does not fall into any special-situation category like Acquisitions, Going-Private, or Capital Returns. The transaction is a standard capital raise. After issuance, shares outstanding will be ~26.5M. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The deal closes on a mutually agreed date. Watch for shareholder dilution and possible Nasdaq listing compliance.
